# NoMineAnimation

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** NoMineAnimation

## What it does

Hides your block mining progress for other players

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/NoMineAnimation.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [RusherHack — NoMineAnimation](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/NoMineAnimation.html)

Hides your block mining progress for other players

Basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/NoMineAnimation.html).

### [Future — NoMineAnimation](https://www.futureclient.net/#features)

Prevents the mining animations from being networked to other players.

Basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features).
